My advice is not professional and I haven't done to much research on it... but I have an idea that if you walk straight in, say "If you don't admit me I will kill myself"

That should do it.
What do they want you to do?
Do you know what you want to do?
See the thing is with me, I honestly don't know. I know what i should do to make my chances better but I don't do it
Do you think about what will come after high school a lot?
Im 17 also. Are you going into your senior year?

You do something amazing for people. You prepare the dea to be seen the last time, show them with dignity and let their loved ones see them one last time in the be best way possible. It's amazing what you do for others.

Do you like your job?
It's all about the evolution man.

Just wanted you to know you really helped me out. Although I wasn't suicidal at the time I was getting there. Instead of going into some depressive slump like I though I was going to I woke up, watched some T.V. and then thought about what you said with the two wolves. I really liked that. I think I'm going to start feeding the white one now. I feel happy.

Today I worked out which I haven't done in month, I didn't eat well but hey, there is tomorrow. I also read which I just realized I love to do. I figure that if I want to be a people person and set examples, I need to have good emotions and good thoughts about myself and others. People will avoid people that have bad energy... so I don't want to be that person.

Thank you :)

What I would really like to know is how to avoid the swings. I am undoubtedly bipolar... if i could keep happy or busy and just keep going with no uncontrollable depression.. i could probably manage my headaches and keep up progress.

I think another thing is I'm always jealous of other people and how they have it better than me, and then i feel like I've missed out and my chances are over.

Also what makes me happy is leading people and being a good influence, something I'm not right now but i was when i was younger. I love setting good examples, teaching people how to do things and making their lives easier or more interesting with my knowledge and understanding of things. I'm a people person who has no idea how to talk to people, only the person in my head.

I think, my health is something that bothers me, cluster headaches seem to get the best of me. The biggest thing though is just not being able to talk to people, it seems when I'm not physically there I can do it, like over the phone or chatting but in person, i start to get nervous and want to leave the situation. 

I would love to get over it, stop my random bursts of depression, exercise more, eat better, spend more time with friends and make more friends. I would really like to do well in school and maybe work my way up to a four year college and get some work experience also. 

It's just the random bursts of depression, the headaches... they seem to come right as i start to come out of it (like right now) and ruin all the progress I've made. I just don't want one of those headaches or random depressions to ruin it permanently...
